$schema.description: JSON schema to validate this file

anyOf.description: RGB colour [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255
RGBA colour [r, g, b, a], each a whole number from 0 to 255; an alpha of 255 is opaque

highAltitude.description: Maximum altitude for interpolation in feet

lowPrecision.description: Precision at low altitude in NM

highPrecision.description: Precision at high altitude in NM

rdf.description: Radio Direction Finder configuration. If not present, RDF will be disabled

color.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.
RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

fontFamily.description: The face of the fix labels: an alias of the manifest's fonts or a font the client bundles (Inter, RobotoMono). Not written: Inter. A name that is neither draws in Inter and is told once in client.log.

fontWeight.description: The weight of the fix labels, drawn by the same coverage window as a map layer's labels. Not written: normal.

lineHeight.description: Pixels from one line's baseline to the next in a fix label. Not written or 0: 12.

align.description: Where each line of a fix label (the name, the ETA, the profile line) sits beside the others. Not written: left.

wordWrap.description: On, a line of a fix label breaks at the last space before it passes wordWrapWidth; a word wider stays whole. Not written: off.

wordWrapWidth.description: Pixels a fix label's line may run to while wordWrap is on. Not written: 100.

outlineColor.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

scaleWithZoom.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Map labels are a constant screen size by design, and the per-size glyph atlases depend on that; zoom-scaled text would need an SDF path.

minZoom.description: The fix labels are hidden below this map zoom. Inclusive. Not written: no lower limit.

maxZoom.description: The fix labels are hidden above this map zoom. Inclusive. Not written: no upper limit.

padding.description: Pixels the plate reaches past the fix label's lines on every side. Used only where backgroundOpacity is above 0. Not written: 0.

backgroundColor.description: The colour of the plate behind each fix label. backgroundOpacity multiplies its alpha; written alone, it draws at its own alpha. Not written: the map background.

cornerRadius.description: Pixels of corner radius on the plate behind each fix label, rounded with whole-pixel steps. Used only where backgroundOpacity is above 0. Not written: square corners.

backgroundOpacity.description: Above 0, one plate is drawn behind each fix label's lines, its colour's alpha times this. Not written: 1 where backgroundColor is written, else no plate.

size.description: Half the point's radius in logical pixels; 0 or less draws the 6 pixel default.

sprite.description: Name of the sprite defined in the sprite atlas

fillColor.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

strokeColor.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

strokeWidth.description: 0 draws no outline, whatever the stroke colour; a cross then takes the line's width.

rotation.description: Rotation of the symbol in degrees

pointStyle.description: Style of the waypoints along the route

headingLegDashArray.description: Dash and gap in pixels of the leg drawn while an aircraft is off its plan laterally. Empty draws it solid; exactly one number is not valid.

inactiveSectorBackgroundColor.description: Background color of the inactive sector, this is the default color of the map

activeSectorBackgroundColor.description: Background color of the user's current active sector

areaOfInterestBackgroundColor.description: Background color of the area of interest, which is around 15% larger than the user's active sector. This is optional and you do not have to display this

neighborSectorBorderLineWidth.description: Line width of the neighbor sector border, this is the line that separates your sector from another active neighbor sectors

lengthNm.description: Length of the extended centerline in nautical miles

thresholdOffsetNm.description: Offset of the extended centerline from the threshold in nautical miles

minorTickSpacingNm.description: Spacing between minor ticks in nautical miles

minorTickLengthNm.description: Length of the minor tick in nautical miles, this does not apply to circle ticks

minorTickWidth.description: Line width of the major tick, or the radius of the circle in arbitrary units

minorTickColor.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

majorTickSpacingNm.description: Spacing between major ticks in nautical miles

majorTickLengthNm.description: Length of the major tick in nautical miles, this does not apply to circle ticks

majorTickWidth.description: Line width of the major tick, or the radius of the circle

majorTickColor.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

headingTool.description: Styling for the heading tools: double-click a target for a straight line, or drag a tag item with a leftDrag of headingPrediction for the turn the aircraft would actually fly. Anything left out falls back to distanceMeasurementTool, then to the aircraft's own speed vector colour.

lineColour.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

textColour.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

dashArray.description: Dash and gap in logical pixels, e.g. [12, 6], for both heading tools. Not written, or a dash of 0 or less or a negative gap, the straight line is solid and the turn tool dashes 12 6; the package check names a refused one.

snapTo.description: The VOR, NDB and fix points the vector's end snaps to while the cursor is over one: the label shows the point's name and the release gives a direct-to it in place of a heading. displayed: only the points this view draws, so it never snaps to one the controller cannot see. all: every point of the package's vor, ndb and fix map layers, drawn or not. Holding Alt while dragging never snaps. TopSky's AHDG known-point snapping.

labelDistance.description: Show the distance in nautical miles from the aircraft to the vector's end, the point it snapped to or the cursor: one decimal below 99.95, else whole. The prediction tool's distance is the track it draws. Shown unless set false; that default is NeoRadar's own, not TopSky's (it corresponds to Vector_AHDG_Label_Dist).

labelTime.description: Show the minutes to go over that distance at the aircraft's ground speed, as 7'. Not shown while the ground speed is 0. Shown unless set false; that default is NeoRadar's own, not TopSky's (it corresponds to Vector_AHDG_Label_Time).

stcaPairLine.description: A line joining the two aircraft of a short term conflict alert while it stands, drawn under the target symbols. Absent draws none; an empty object draws a solid red line one logical pixel wide. It follows the alert board, so safetyNets.show hiding stca removes it, and it draws only between two aircraft this view draws a symbol for. TopSky has no such line.

color.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so. Red when absent.

lineWidth.description: Line width in logical pixels, 1 when absent.

dashArray.description: Dash and gap in logical pixels, e.g. [6, 4]. Absent is solid.

flightPlanSeparationTool.description: FPLSEP, TopSky's predicted minimum separation along the planned routes: a line from each aircraft to where it will be at the minimum, and the minimum and the time to it beside them. Absent, and every key absent, draws in TopSky's FPLSEP orange (255, 170, 46) so the tool is told apart from RADARSEP, which takes the distanceMeasurementTool colours.

lineColour.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so. FPLSEP orange when absent.

textColour.description: The label's colour, the line colour when absent.

lineWidth.description: Line width in logical pixels, 1 when absent.

tctLeg.description: The TCT legs: both predicted paths to the closest point, plain to the conflict start and embellished beyond, and a label on the other aircraft's leg placed and filled as TopSky's TCT_Label_* settings. Absent draws TopSky's colours and layout.

colour.description: Up to the conflict start. TopSky's (220, 214, 20) when absent.

embellishedColour.description: From the conflict start to the closest point. TopSky's (254, 102, 39) when absent.

labelColour.description: The minimum and the time to it. TopSky's (220, 214, 20) when absent.

lineWidth.description: Line width in logical pixels, 2 when absent.

embellished.description: Draw the conflict part of the leg in embellishedColour, TopSky's TCT_Leg_Embellished.

labelAnchor.description: Where on the other aircraft's leg the label hangs: the start of the conflict (TopSky's default) or the closest point.

labelAngleDeg.description: Direction of the label from the anchor, degrees clockwise from the leg's direction there, TopSky's TCT_Label_Pos_Angle.

labelDistancePx.description: Distance of the label's centre from the anchor, TopSky's TCT_Label_Pos_Distance.

labelData.description: Which point the distance and time describe, TopSky's TCT_Label_Data_Ref.

labelDistance.description: The distance's place beside the time, TopSky's TCT_Label_Distance.

blindSpot.description: The Blind Spot bars in the CFL, heading and direct-to menus. A colour named here wins over the theme's Action.BlindSpot token for this system; absent uses the theme (TopSky's values).

conflictColour.description: A conflict starting within the window.

crossedLevelColour.description: Clear, but a conflicting level lies between it and the present one.

unknownColour.description: The probe could not judge it.

startCircleColour.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

endCircleColour.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

dashedLineColour.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

distanceTextColour.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

startBearingTextColour.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

endBearingTextColour.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

width.description: Line width in logical pixels. Never drawn thinner than 1.

dashArray.description: Dash, gap, dash, gap and so on, in logical pixels: an even number of values, repeated along the line. An odd count repeats with dashes and gaps swapped; a value of 0 or less draws solid

type.description: The built-in symbol, a sprite, or shape for the shape named by shape. Lower case only: any other value reads as absent and the package check says so.

size.description: The dot's radius in logical pixels. 0 draws the layer's own 3 pixel dot; a negative size draws no dot.

shape.description: With type shape: the name of a shape in systems/shapes.json, drawn at each point in its own colours and design units, growing with the display scale. A feature's own symbol is drawn in its place.

color.description: RGBA colour [r, g, b, a] or [r, g, b], each a whole number from 0 to 255, the alpha too (255 is opaque). Any other value reads as absent and the package check says so. The label's red, green and blue; a label is always drawn opaque. Not written: each label takes its point's colour.

fontFamily.description: The face the layer's labels draw in: an alias of the manifest's fonts or a font the client bundles (Inter, RobotoMono). Not written: the manifest's default style for the layer, else Inter. A name that is neither draws in Inter and is told once in client.log.

fontSize.description: Label size in pixels. Not written: 10, or 11 on a layer named label.

fontWeight.description: Coarse stroke weight, applied as a coverage threshold shift so no second atlas is needed. Overridden by textWeight when both are set.

textWeight.description: Fine stroke weight. Negative thins the strokes, positive thickens them, 0 is the font's own weight. Overrides fontWeight.

textSharpness.description: Edge hardness. 0 keeps the rasteriser's own antialiasing, 1 gives a near-binary edge. A negative textWeight with some sharpness gives a thin, crisp look.

lineHeight.description: Pixels from one line's baseline to the next, in the label's own size. A label breaks at each line break in its text, and at spaces with wordWrap. Not written or 0: 1.2 times the font size.

align.description: Where each line of a label sits beside the others. Not written: left.

wordWrap.description: On, a line breaks at the last space before it passes wordWrapWidth; a word wider than that stays whole. Not written: off.

wordWrapWidth.description: Pixels a line may run to while wordWrap is on, in the label's own size. Not written: 100.

scaleWithZoom.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Map labels are a constant screen size by design, and the per-size glyph atlases depend on that; zoom-scaled text would need an SDF path.

minZoom.description: The labels are hidden below this map zoom, on the scale the layer's own minimum zoom is on. Inclusive. Not written: no lower limit.

maxZoom.description: The labels are hidden above this map zoom. Inclusive. Not written: no upper limit.

padding.description: Pixels the plate reaches past the text on every side, in the label's own size. Used only where backgroundOpacity is above 0. Not written: 0.

backgroundColor.description: The colour of the plate behind the layer's labels. backgroundOpacity multiplies its alpha; written alone, it draws at its own alpha. Not written: the map background.

backgroundOpacity.description: Above 0, a plate is drawn behind each label and over the map under it, its colour's alpha times this. Not written: 1 where backgroundColor is written, else no plate.

geodesic.description: Whether a long oblique segment is drawn as the great circle between its ends instead of the straight Mercator chord. Default true. Segments under 20 km and segments whose ends share a latitude (a parallel) are always straight. Overridable per feature with a top-level geodesic property. The server projects sector volumes with the same rule.

layerStyles.description: Layer styles for the map, this is a dictionary of layer names to layer styles, and overrides the default values in the manifest for the layer

screenTypes.description: Map style laid over this one for a view whose profile names the screen type: a map of screen type names, as a profile's screenType key writes them, to the keys that differ on that screen type. A block is merged key by key, so a screenType writes only what it changes; a list or a value replaces the base one whole.

additionalProperties.description: The mapstyle keys this screen type changes, merged over the base: any key a mapstyle takes but screenTypes.
